```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
    echo      = FALSE,
    warning   = FALSE,
    message   = FALSE,
    fig.align = "center",
    dpi       = 150
)

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

# Palette couleurs pipeline
COL_PRIMARY   <- "#2C3E50"
COL_SECONDARY <- "#E67E22"
COL_ACCENT    <- "#E74C3C"

# Tableau HTML : knitr::kable seul (pas de dépendance kableExtra)
show_table <- function(x, caption = NULL) {
    knitr::kable(x, caption = caption, format = "html", table.attr = "class=\"table table-striped\"")
}
```

## 1. Résumé du pipeline

```{r pipeline_info}
info <- data.frame(
    Paramètre = c(
        "Version du pipeline",
        "Date d'analyse",
        "Modèle GWAS",
        "Seuil MAF",
        "Génome de référence"
    ),
    Valeur = c(
        params$pipeline_version,
        params$run_date,
        params$gwas_model,
        params$maf_threshold,
        "Amel_HAv3.1 (GCF_003254395.2)"
    )
)
show_table(info, caption="Paramètres du pipeline")
```

## 2. Contrôle qualité des variants

```{r vcf_stats}
stats_file <- file.path(params$results_dir, "cohort.stats.txt")
if (file.exists(stats_file)) {
    lines <- readLines(stats_file)
    sn_lines <- lines[grepl("^SN", lines)]
    sn_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(sn_lines, function(l) {
        parts <- strsplit(l, "\t")[[1]]
        data.frame(Métrique=parts[3], Valeur=parts[4])
    }))
    show_table(sn_df, caption="Statistiques du VCF filtré")
} else {
    cat("Fichier de statistiques VCF non trouvé.")
}
```

## 3. Structure de population

### 3.1 Analyse en Composantes Principales (PCA)

```{r pca_plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
pca_file <- file.path(params$results_dir, "honeybee.eigenvec")
if (file.exists(pca_file)) {
    df <- read.table(pca_file, header=FALSE)
    colnames(df)[1:2] <- c("FID","IID")
    n_pc <- ncol(df) - 2
    colnames(df)[3:ncol(df)] <- paste0("PC", 1:n_pc)
    df$Population <- sub("_[^_]+_[^_]+$", "", df$IID)

    ggplot(df, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, colour=Population)) +
        geom_point(size=3, alpha=0.85) +
        stat_ellipse(level=0.95, linetype="dashed") +
        labs(
            title = "PCA — Structure de population",
            x     = "PC1", y = "PC2"
        ) +
        theme_classic(base_size=12) +
        theme(plot.title=element_text(face="bold"))
} else {
    cat("Fichier PCA non trouvé.")
}
```

### 3.2 Structure ADMIXTURE

```{r admixture_plot, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
q_files <- list.files(params$results_dir,
                      pattern="\\.Q$", full.names=TRUE)
if (length(q_files) > 0) {
    plots <- lapply(sort(q_files), function(f) {
        k  <- as.integer(gsub(".*\\.(\\d+)\\.Q$", "\\1", basename(f)))
        q  <- read.table(f, header=FALSE)
        colnames(q) <- paste0("Anc", 1:ncol(q))
        q$Sample <- paste0("S", 1:nrow(q))
        q_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(q, -Sample,
                                      names_to="Ancestry",
                                      values_to="Proportion")
        ggplot(q_long, aes(x=Sample, y=Proportion, fill=Ancestry)) +
            geom_bar(stat="identity", width=1) +
            scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0)) +
            labs(title=sprintf("K = %d", k), x=NULL) +
            theme_classic(base_size=9) +
            theme(axis.text.x=element_blank(),
                  axis.ticks.x=element_blank())
    })
    for (p in plots) print(p)
} else {
    cat("Fichiers ADMIXTURE non trouvés.")
}
```

## 4. Résultats GWAS

### 4.1 Manhattan plot

```{r manhattan, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
# Le fichier est stagé à plat par Nextflow (collect) — on le cherche
# aussi bien à la racine que dans un sous-dossier output/.
assoc_candidates <- c(
    file.path(params$results_dir, "honeybee.assoc.annotated.txt"),
    file.path(params$results_dir, "output/honeybee.assoc.annotated.txt")
)
assoc_file <- assoc_candidates[file.exists(assoc_candidates)][1]
if (!is.na(assoc_file) && file.exists(assoc_file)) {
    df <- read.table(assoc_file, header=TRUE, sep="\t")
    if ("p_wald" %in% names(df)) df$P <- df$p_wald
    if ("ps"     %in% names(df)) df$BP  <- as.numeric(df$ps)
    # 'chr' GEMMA peut être un accession NCBI (NC_037638.1) : on mappe
    # chaque chromosome/contig distinct vers un entier séquentiel.
    chr_raw <- if ("chr" %in% names(df)) as.character(df$chr) else as.character(df$CHR)
    df$CHR <- match(chr_raw, sort(unique(chr_raw)))
    df <- df[!is.na(df$P) & df$P > 0 & !is.na(df$CHR) & !is.na(df$BP), ]
    df$LOG10P <- -log10(df$P)

    n_snps     <- nrow(df)
    bonferroni <- 0.05 / n_snps

    chr_lengths <- df %>%
        group_by(CHR) %>%
        summarise(max_bp=max(BP), .groups='drop') %>%
        arrange(CHR) %>%
        mutate(bp_offset=cumsum(lag(max_bp, default=0)))

    df <- df %>%
        left_join(chr_lengths, by="CHR") %>%
        mutate(BP_cum=BP + bp_offset)

    axis_df <- df %>%
        group_by(CHR) %>%
        summarise(center=(max(BP_cum)+min(BP_cum))/2, .groups='drop')

    ggplot(df, aes(x=BP_cum, y=LOG10P, colour=as.factor(CHR))) +
        geom_point(size=0.6, alpha=0.7) +
        scale_colour_manual(
            values=rep(c(COL_PRIMARY, COL_SECONDARY), 16)
        ) +
        scale_x_continuous(labels=axis_df$CHR,
                            breaks=axis_df$center) +
        geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(bonferroni),
                   colour="red", linetype="dashed") +
        geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(1e-5),
                   colour="orange", linetype="dashed") +
        labs(
            title = "Manhattan Plot — GWAS",
            x     = "Chromosome",
            y     = expression(-log[10](p))
        ) +
        theme_classic(base_size=11) +
        theme(legend.position="none",
              plot.title=element_text(face="bold"))
} else {
    cat("Fichier de résultats GWAS non trouvé.")
}
```

### 4.2 Top SNPs significatifs

```{r top_snps}
if (exists("df") && all(c("P","LOG10P","CHR","BP") %in% names(df)) && nrow(df) > 0) {
    top_snps <- df %>%
        arrange(P) %>%
        head(20) %>%
        select(CHR, BP, P, LOG10P) %>%
        mutate(
            P       = formatC(P, format="e", digits=2),
            LOG10P  = round(LOG10P, 2)
        )
    knitr::kable(top_snps,
                 caption="Top 20 SNPs les plus significatifs",
                 format="html", table.attr="class=\"table table-striped\"",
                 col.names=c("Chr","Position","p-value","-log10(p)"))
}
```
